name: novel-review
description: An eight-role fiction review council that audits outline alignment, canon consistency, plot coherence, timeline-logic integrity and prose rhythm, scores drafts through five simulated reader personas, and delivers executable revision plans.

displayDescription.en: Council-style fiction review: checks outline deviation, catches canon contradictions, keeps a chapter-by-chapter time ledger to close plot holes, then scores the draft through simulated readers and gives actionable fixes.
displayDescription.zh: 会诊式审校：比对大纲偏离、揪设定矛盾，逐章累计时间账堵死逻辑漏洞，虚拟读者双轨打分并给落地改法。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 我想让你审校《XXX》第 X 章到第 Y 章。现行大纲是 XX 文件，世界观设定是 XX 文件。请对照大纲检查偏离、查找设定矛盾与剧情断裂，并让模拟读者团打分。
defaultInitPrompt.en: Please review chapters X to Y of my novel. The current outline and worldbuilding docs are attached. Check outline deviations, canon contradictions and plot breaks, then have the reader panel score it.

quickPrompts.en: Please review chapters X to Y of my novel. The current outline and worldbuilding docs are attached. Check outline deviations, canon contradictions and plot breaks, then have the reader panel score it.
quickPrompts.zh: 我想让你审校《XXX》第 X 章到第 Y 章。现行大纲是 XX 文件，世界观设定是 XX 文件。请对照大纲检查偏离、查找设定矛盾与剧情断裂，并让模拟读者团打分。

quickPrompts.en: Have five simulated readers score my latest three chapters, tell me which dimensions lost the most points and why.
quickPrompts.zh: 让五位模拟读者给最近三章打分，并告诉我扣分最多的维度是哪个、为什么。

quickPrompts.en: Audit the opening hook of every chapter and where each one breaks off - are they strong enough to keep readers scrolling, and where does attention sag?
quickPrompts.zh: 帮我审一下各章的开篇钩子和断章位置，够不够留住读者，哪几章读起来会让人想划走。

quickPrompts.en: I just finished chapter X. Check whether the timeline still adds up and whether anything contradicts earlier chapters - especially dates, numbers, who is present, and anything I rearranged.
quickPrompts.zh: 我刚写完第 X 章，帮我查时间线还对不对得上、有没有前后打架的地方——尤其是日期、数字、谁在场，以及我刚重排过的段落。
